description: current streak, longest streak, and 30-day completion rate per habit
spec:
1. Implement a streak service that derives stats from a habit's check-ins.
2. Compute current streak as the run of consecutive done days ending today (or yesterday).
3. Compute longest streak as the longest consecutive run ever recorded.
4. Compute a 30-day completion rate (done days / 30).
5. Ensure a missed day breaks the current streak but preserves the longest streak.
6. Handle gaps correctly across month boundaries.
7. Expose GET /api/v1/habits/:id/stats returning currentStreak, longestStreak, completionRate.
8. Confirm an empty check-in history yields zero streaks and zero completion.
9. Confirm checking today after a gap restarts the current streak at 1.
10. Verify longest streak never decreases when current streak resets.
11. Run `bun run smoke:qc` and confirm it passes.
title: Streak and completion computation
